Onboarding.title: Onboarding case
Onboarding.description: A deterministic onboarding case (one per hire): the concrete legal gates for a new employee's first week. Contract signed, WID identity check, BSN/IBAN validated, IT provisioned, pensioen aangemeld. As checklist boolean/date fields, governed by a simplified six-state declarative lifecycle (onboarding-wizard-mvp). MVP-scoped from the 2026-05 spec/onboarding-wizard draft's 13-state machine and 15-step wizard stepper: no OnboardingStep/WIDCheck/BSNValidatie/Reminder side entities, no wizard stepper UI (follow-up nc-vue widget, design.md D6), no BSN elfproef/IBAN modulus-97 validation services, no IT auto-provisioning, no reminder/escalation engine. The checklist gates named on each lifecycle transition are enforced by audit rules (lib/Standards/Checks/NlOnboardingChecks.php), except the right-to-work check, which RightToWorkGuard enforces at write time on gereed_melden and starten (people-dossier-completeness). Guard wiring for compliance-checked schemas is owned by the active humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement change (design.md D2).

contract_bevestigen.description: The employment contract has been signed. Checklist gate: contractSigned = true (enforced by audit rule, not a write-time guard. See humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement).

gegevens_valideren.description: The hire's BSN and IBAN have been checked. Checklist gate: bsnValidated = true AND ibanVerified = true (audit-enforced).

gereed_melden.description: The case is ready for the first workday. Hard stop: the employee needs a passing right-to-work check dated on or before startDate (RightToWorkGuard, people-dossier-completeness D5; Wet op de identificatieplicht art. 15 jo. Wet LB 1964 art. 28 lid 1 onder f, Wet arbeid vreemdelingen art. 2). Checklist gates itProvisioned = true and pensioenAangemeld = true stay audit-enforced.

starten.description: startDate has been reached; the proeftijd clock now runs against proeftijdEndDate (BW 7:652). Refused without a passing right-to-work check dated on or before startDate (RightToWorkGuard).

afronden.description: The proeftijd completed without termination; the onboarding case is closed out.

annuleren.description: The hire is cancelled (no-show, or proeftijd termination) before the case reaches afgerond.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Employee this onboarding case hires.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: The first working day. The identity check and the probation period are both counted from here.
startDate.x-notes: First workday. Anchor date for the WID identity check timing (nl-onboarding-wid-check) and the proeftijd clock.

proeftijdEndDate.title: Probation end date
proeftijdEndDate.description: When the probation period ends, if one was agreed. Leave empty when there is none.
proeftijdEndDate.x-notes: End of the probationary period, if agreed. BW 7:652-capped (max 1 month for fixed-term contracts under 2 years, max 2 months for permanent/2+ year contracts) but a contractual input, not derived — checked by nl-onboarding-proeftijd-bewaking. Null when no proeftijd was agreed.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this case has got to, from hired through to completed. It can be cancelled until it is completed.
status.x-notes: Case lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (aangenomen -> contract_getekend -> gegevens_gevalideerd -> gereed_eerste_werkdag -> proeftijd_lopend -> afgerond, cancellable pre-afgerond).

contractSigned.title: Contract signed
contractSigned.description: The signed employment contract is on file. Required before the case can move on.
contractSigned.x-notes: Whether the signed employment contract is on file (artefact stored in the files widget). Gates the contract_bevestigen transition.

widCheckDone.title: Identity check done
widCheckDone.description: The identity check was done: the original document was seen and a copy filed. Must happen on or before the first working day.
widCheckDone.x-notes: Whether the WID identity check was performed (original document seen, copy retained per Wet LB 1964 art. 28 lid 1 onder f). Must be true on or before startDate; checked by nl-onboarding-wid-check.

widCheckDate.title: Identity check date
widCheckDate.description: Date the WID identity check was performed.

bsnValidated.title: BSN validated
bsnValidated.description: Whether the BSN was checked. Records the outcome only: elfproef modulus-11 automation is a non-goal.

ibanVerified.title: IBAN verified
ibanVerified.description: Whether the IBAN was verified. Records the outcome only: modulus-97 automation is a non-goal.

itProvisioned.title: IT provisioned
itProvisioned.description: Whether the Nextcloud/IT account was provisioned for the hire. Records the outcome only: OCS auto-provisioning is a non-goal.

pensioenAangemeld.title: Registered with the pension fund
pensioenAangemeld.description: Whether the hire has been registered with the pension fund/administrator.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Anything worth noting about this case.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this case belongs to. Normally the same as the employee's.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this Onboarding case is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7), mirroring its employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007). The implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

Offboarding.title: Offboarding case
Offboarding.description: A deterministic offboarding case (one per departure): the concrete gates for a leaving employee. Exit interview held, assets returned, access revoked. And the statutory eindafrekening components (verlofsaldo paid out, vakantiegeld settled, transitievergoeding recorded, getuigschrift provided) as checklist boolean/date fields, governed by a simplified five-state declarative lifecycle (offboarding-wizard-mvp). MVP-scoped from the 2026-05 spec/offboarding-wizard draft's 17-state machine and 7 entity schemas: no OffboardingStep/Eindafrekening/EquipmentReturn/ExitInterview/Getuigschrift/RetentionTimer side entities, no eindafrekening computation engine, no UWV WW-melding/pensioenfonds/ZVW submissions, no AVG retention timers, no per-item asset tracking (the parallel asset-management-mvp owns asset data. Loose coupling only, design.md D6). The checklist gates named on each lifecycle transition are enforced by audit rules (lib/Standards/Checks/NlOffboardingChecks.php), NOT by write-time guard classes. Guard wiring for compliance-checked schemas is owned by the active humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement change (design.md D2).

x-openregister-flows.name: Toegang intrekken na laatste werkdag
x-openregister-flows.description: Each morning disables the Nextcloud account of every leaver whose last working day has passed and whose case is still open, and ticks Access revoked on the case, recorded as done by humaniq. An administrator account is never disabled this way. The flow arrives disabled; until an administrator enables it, HR revokes access with the Revoke access action (hiring-offboarding-completion D2).

afronding_plannen.description: lastWorkingDay is confirmed; the exit gesprek, asset return and access revocation are planned (no field gate on this transition).

eindafrekening_gereedmelden.description: The eindafrekening is ready. Checklist gate: verlofsaldoUitbetaald = true when an open leave balance remains (BW 7:641), vakantiegeldAfgerekend = true, transitievergoedingBedrag recorded for dismissal-initiated reasons (BW 7:673) (enforced by audit rule, not a write-time guard. See humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement).

afronden.description: The case is closed out. Checklist gate: exitGesprekDone recorded, assetsIngeleverd = true, toegangIngetrokken = true, getuigschriftVerstrekt on request (BW 7:656), Employee.endDate equals lastWorkingDay (BW 7:667) (audit-enforced).

annuleren.description: The departure is withdrawn (opzegging ingetrokken / VSO niet getekend) before the case reaches afgerond.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Employee this offboarding case concerns.

lastWorkingDay.title: Last working day
lastWorkingDay.x-notes: The employee's last working day; anchor date for the einddatum-consistentie rule (nl-offboarding-einddatum-consistentie, BW 7:667).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the employee is leaving. This decides whether a statutory transition payment is due.
reason.x-notes: The departure reason. Drives transitievergoeding applicability (BW 7:673) — opzegging-werkgever and einde-contract (non-renewal) are dismissal-initiated; opzegging-werknemer, pensioen and overlijden are statutorily exempt; vso severance is negotiated, not statutory.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this case has got to, from announced through to completed. It can be cancelled until it is completed.
status.x-notes: Case lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (aangekondigd -> afronding_gepland -> eindafrekening_gereed -> afgerond, cancellable pre-afgerond).

exitGesprekDone.title: Exit interview done
exitGesprekDone.description: When the exit interview was held. Required before the case can be completed.
exitGesprekDone.x-notes: Date the exit interview was held; null while pending. Gates the afronden transition.

assetsIngeleverd.title: Assets returned
assetsIngeleverd.description: Company property has been handed back. Records the outcome only: individual items are tracked separately.
assetsIngeleverd.x-notes: Whether company property was returned. Records the outcome only — per-item tracking is the parallel asset-management-mvp's domain (design.md D6).

toegangIngetrokken.title: Access revoked
toegangIngetrokken.description: Whether the leaver's Nextcloud account has been disabled. Revoke access disables it and ticks this for you.

toegangIngetrokkenDoor.title: Access revoked by
toegangIngetrokkenDoor.description: Who revoked the access, or humaniq when the daily flow did.

toegangIngetrokkenToelichting.title: Access note
toegangIngetrokkenToelichting.description: Why there was no account to disable, such as No Nextcloud account.
toegangIngetrokkenToelichting.x-notes: hiring-offboarding-completion D2: set when the employee has no nextcloudUserId.

verlofsaldoUitbetaald.title: Leave balance paid out
verlofsaldoUitbetaald.description: The remaining leave balance has been paid out, as the law requires.
verlofsaldoUitbetaald.x-notes: Whether the open leave balance was paid out (BW art. 7:641). Checked cross-object by nl-offboarding-verlofsaldo-uitbetaling against the employee's LeaveBalance rows.

vakantiegeldAfgerekend.title: Holiday allowance settled
vakantiegeldAfgerekend.description: Whether accrued vakantiegeld was settled in the eindafrekening.

transitievergoedingBedrag.title: Transition payment amount
transitievergoedingBedrag.description: The gross statutory transition payment in euros. Required when the employer initiated the departure; leave empty otherwise.
transitievergoedingBedrag.x-notes: Gross statutory transition payment in EUR (BW art. 7:673); required data for dismissal-initiated reasons, null when not applicable. Recorded input, not derived — the formula constants live as parameters on the nl-offboarding-transitievergoeding rule.

transitievergoedingBerekening.title: Transition payment calculation
transitievergoedingBerekening.description: What Calculate transition payment worked out: service years, monthly wage parts, the cap and whether it applied. The amount above can be changed afterwards; this keeps what the calculation said.
transitievergoedingBerekening.x-notes: hiring-offboarding-completion D3: written by TransitionPaymentService from TransitionPaymentCalculator.

getuigschriftVerstrekt.title: Reference letter issued
getuigschriftVerstrekt.description: A reference letter was given to the leaver, as the law requires on request.
getuigschriftVerstrekt.x-notes: Whether the getuigschrift was provided to the leaver (BW art. 7:656; generated via the existing docudesk getuigschrift document type).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Anything worth noting about this case.

ExitInterview.title: Exit interview
ExitInterview.description: What a leaver said in the exit interview: their own main reason for leaving, whether they would recommend the organisation and come back, and what worked and what could be better. After 90 days the person link and the free text are cleared; the reason, the scores, the department and the date stay for reporting (hiring-offboarding-completion D1).

x-openregister-flows.name: Exit interviews anonymiseren
x-openregister-flows.description: Each night clears the employee, the case, who held it and both free-text answers of every exit interview held more than 90 days ago, and stamps when it did. The reason, the scores, the department and the date stay. The flow arrives disabled; until an administrator enables it, exit interviews keep their person link (hiring-offboarding-completion D1).

offboardingId.title: Offboarding case
offboardingId.description: The departure this interview belongs to. Recording the interview fills in the case's exit interview date.
offboardingId.x-notes: Cleared after 90 days by the anonymisation flow.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: Who is leaving. Filled in from the case when left empty.
employeeId.x-notes: Cleared after 90 days by the anonymisation flow.

orgUnitId.title: Department
orgUnitId.description: The leaver's department, kept after the interview is anonymised so reasons can be compared per department. Filled in from the leaver's placement when left empty.

heldOn.title: Held on
heldOn.description: The day the exit interview was held.

conductedBy.title: Held by
conductedBy.x-notes: Cleared after 90 days by the anonymisation flow.

mainReason.title: Main reason
mainReason.description: The leaver's own main reason for leaving. This is their motive, not the legal ground on the case.

wouldRecommend.title: Would recommend
wouldRecommend.description: From 0 to 10, how likely the leaver is to recommend the organisation as an employer.

wouldReturn.title: Would come back
wouldReturn.description: Whether the leaver would consider coming back.

whatWorked.title: What worked
whatWorked.x-notes: Cleared after 90 days by the anonymisation flow.

whatToImprove.title: What could be better
whatToImprove.x-notes: Cleared after 90 days by the anonymisation flow.

anonymisedAt.title: Anonymised at
anonymisedAt.description: When the person link and the free text were cleared. Empty while the interview still names the leaver.
